title: mtx_spherical_harmonics
description: `mtx_spherical_harmonics` evaluates spherical harmonics at points supplied as azimuth and zenith coordinates in a 2×L input matrix, producing an output matrix whose columns are ordered by k=n²+n+m+1. It requires a numerical `nmax` creation argument for the maximum order and supports normalization choices such as SN3D, N3D, and N3D4PI.
